usedFor: MailChimp holds your subscribers, and TeamWave gets a deal for each new one through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new subscriber is added to an audience” in MailChimp, then “Create Deal” in TeamWave
bestTemplate.why: Each new subscriber becomes a deal in TeamWave, so sales can follow up on interest from your list.

watchOut: “Create Deal” adds no follower or activity, so use “Add Follower” and “Create Activity” for those.
